label: Artemis II Mission Status
delta: Day 48: FAA formally grounds Starship (IFT-12 investigation); Artemis III crew reveal June 9 — 12 days away; Moon Base ~$1B contracts announced May 26.
deltaNote: Day 48: Artemis II crew at JSC Houston. FAA formally grounded Starship May 27-28 pending IFT-12 mishap investigation — IFT-13 blocked from flight license until corrective actions approved (earliest Q3 2026). June 9 Artemis III crew announcement: NASA international media RSVP deadline passed May 28; first astronaut names attached to the redesigned LEO docking test (late 2027). May 26 Moon Base news conference: ~$1B to Astrolab ($219M CLV-1 rover), Lunar Outpost ($220M Pegasus LTV), Blue Origin ($188M Blue Moon Endurance lander), Firefly (MoonFall drones). Moon Base I targeting fall 2026; Artemis IV first crewed landing 2028. MSFC fabricating Artemis III structural spacer; ICPS reserved for Artemis IV.
